description: A targeted phishing campaign was launched against corporate employees using a spoofed Microsoft 365 login page. An employee received a fraudulent email claiming that their mailbox would be suspended unless immediate action was taken. The user clicked the malicious link, entered corporate credentials into a fake login portal, and unknowingly exposed their username and password. Shortly afterward, the attacker authenticated successfully from an external IP address and accessed internal corporate resources.

attack_steps.subject: Urgent: Mailbox Verification Required
attack_steps.description: User receives a phishing email impersonating Microsoft 365 support.
User clicks a malicious URL embedded in the phishing email.
User enters corporate credentials into a fraudulent login page.
IDS identifies outbound communication with a known phishing infrastructure.
Firewall records outbound HTTPS connection to phishing domain.
Successful login observed from an unusual geographic location shortly after credential theft.
Attacker accesses sensitive internal resources using compromised credentials.
Large volume of file access activity suggests data collection by the attacker.

rule_1.name: Phishing Email to Malicious URL Access
rule_1.description: Correlate phishing email indicators with outbound access to suspicious domains.

rule_2.name: Credential Theft Followed by Login
rule_2.description: Detect successful authentication shortly after phishing activity.

rule_3.name: Firewall Connection to Known Phishing Domain
rule_3.description: Correlate outbound firewall traffic with known phishing infrastructure.

rule_4.name: Suspicious Login and Resource Access
rule_4.description: Detect unusual successful login followed by access to sensitive resources.

observed_indicators: Access to sensitive resources immediately after login

recommended_actions.description: Temporarily disable the affected account to prevent further unauthorized access.
Force password reset and revoke active authentication sessions.
Require multi-factor authentication for all affected and privileged accounts.
Block phishing domains and URLs at firewall, proxy, and DNS layers.
Review accessed resources and determine whether data exposure occurred.
Provide phishing awareness training to affected users and departments.

executive_summary: A critical phishing attack successfully targeted a corporate employee using a spoofed Microsoft 365 email. The victim clicked a malicious link and entered credentials into a fraudulent login page, resulting in credential theft. IDS systems detected phishing-related activity while firewall logs recorded outbound connections to malicious infrastructure. Shortly afterward, a successful login occurred from an external attacker IP address, followed by access to sensitive corporate resources. The incident has been assigned a risk score of 90 due to confirmed credential compromise and unauthorized resource access. Immediate remediation includes account disablement, credential reset, MFA enforcement, and blocking of identified phishing infrastructure.
